text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Today's training was so tiring too...
My arms and legs are completely jelly—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ On a day like this,
I'll lay out the rug my father gave me and...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... So fluffy and comfy!
Now, just gotta chug down some milk and...—Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I spilled it! I have to wash it right away!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The stain... Urgh, no... It's spreading...
...Dad...
